project: SVA Residential Traffic & Micromobility Safety Sentinel
description: Autonomous Edge Vision & Auditing System for residential street intersection monitoring, detecting wrong-way vehicular and micromobility infractions (cars, e-scooters, bicycles) under an 8GB RAM Docker budget. Heavy training, knowledge distillation, and model quantization are offloaded to rented Google Colab GPUs (A100/L4), deploying an OpenVINO INT8 centinel detector and a llama.cpp GGUF forensic auditor to a local FastAPI asyncio pipeline, MLFlow observability server, and Next.js incident timeline dashboard.

features.name: docker_environment_and_dependency_scaffolding
features.title: Containerized Runtime Architecture and 8GB RAM Budget Allocation
features.description: Establish the project repository structure (backend/, frontend/, configs/, data/, models/, colab_notebooks/, docker/) and configure multi-service docker-compose with strict cgroup memory caps (API: 4GB, MLFlow: 1.5GB, Next.js: 1GB, Host reserve: 1.5GB) optimized for local CPU edge inference without heavy training bloat.
acceptance: Create structured workspace layout separating edge inference, Google Colab training notebooks, and frontend
Author docker-compose.yml with memory hard limits (mem_limit: 4g for inference, 1.5g for mlflow, 1g for nextjs)
Configure pyproject.toml specifying edge runtime dependencies: fastapi, uvicorn, opencv-python-headless, openvino, llama-cpp-python, mlflow, supervision, pydantic
Verify container startup health checks without exceeding the 8GB aggregate system RAM ceiling

features.name: camera_rtsp_and_homography_calibration
features.title: Ground-Level Camera Ingestion and Planar Homography Calibration
features.description: Implement camera calibration scripts to compute the 3x3 homography matrix H converting 2D ground-level image coordinates (u, v) into real-world metric intersection coordinates (X, Y in meters), defining authorized traffic direction vectors for each street lane.
acceptance: Create interactive OpenCV utility to select 4 ground control points on the intersection pavement to establish metric plane H
Generate configs/homography_config.json storing matrix H, lane polygon boundaries, and directional vector thresholds
Define mathematical unit vector u_legal for vehicular and micromobility lanes to detect counter-flow movement
Validate projected world coordinate accuracy with test pavement calibration measurements (< 5% distance error)

features.name: huggingface_dataset_acquisition_and_curation
features.title: Hugging Face Multimodal Traffic & Micromobility Dataset Ingestion
features.description: Automate download, filtering, and normalization of public datasets from Hugging Face (starwit/overhead-traffic-anomalies, UniqueData/electric-scooters-tracking, and street-level vehicle datasets) focused on bicycles, e-scooters, and street vehicles in urban/residential contexts.
acceptance: Implement data/ingest_hf_datasets.py downloading target subsets via huggingface_hub with resume capabilities
Standardize heterogeneous annotations into unified YOLO format with target classes: car, motorcycle, bicycle, e-scooter, pedestrian
Filter and augment dataset with lighting, occlusions, and ground-level perspective transformations matching the IP camera viewpoint
Generate deterministic train/val/test splits (70/20/10) with verified class balance and label integrity manifests

features.name: base_models_acquisition_and_registry
features.title: Hugging Face Teacher & Student Base Model Checkpoint Acquisition
features.description: Download and register base model checkpoints from Hugging Face Hub: heavy teacher models (YOLO11x / RT-DETR-X), lightweight target detector student (YOLO11n), and base instruction-tuned language model for incident reasoning to be converted for llama.cpp.
acceptance: Create scripts/download_base_models.py fetching PyTorch/SafeTensors weights with SHA256 checksum verification
Store base models in structured artifact directory models/base/ with versioning metadata
Validate baseline inference execution and zero-shot mAP on sample intersection test frames
Log baseline FP32 latency, parameter count, and memory allocation into initial registry

features.name: colab_gpu_yolo_knowledge_distillation
features.title: Google Colab GPU Knowledge Distillation Pipeline (Teacher YOLO11x to Student YOLO11n)
features.description: Develop and execute a Google Colab Pro notebook leveraging rented high-performance GPUs (NVIDIA A100 or L4 with 24-40GB VRAM) to train student YOLO11n from teacher YOLO11x using composite response-based and feature-based knowledge distillation.
acceptance: Create colab_notebooks/01_yolo_knowledge_distillation.ipynb with automatic Google Drive / Hugging Face data synchronization
Implement composite distillation loss L_total = alpha * L_hard + beta * L_KD(teacher, student; temp=tau) + gamma * L_feat
Execute distributed/mixed-precision distillation on rented Colab GPU achieving >= 92% of teacher mAP@50 while reducing parameters by > 80%
Export distilled student weights (PyTorch/ONNX) and push checkpoints to Hugging Face Model Hub / MLFlow remote registry

features.name: colab_llamacpp_auditor_finetuning_and_export
features.title: Google Colab Auditor Fine-Tuning and llama.cpp GGUF Conversion
features.description: Fine-tune a lightweight instruction model in Google Colab GPU on residential traffic infraction reasoning (extracting entity, speed, counter-flow direction, risk level) and convert the fine-tuned model into GGUF format using llama.cpp conversion scripts.
acceptance: Create colab_notebooks/02_auditor_finetuning_llamacpp.ipynb utilizing Colab GPU (L4/A100) for LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning
Train model on 1,000 curated traffic violation telemetry prompts paired with verified structured JSON forensic verdicts
Merge LoRA adapters and convert full model into GGUF base format using llama.cpp convert_hf_to_gguf.py
Verify converted GGUF model produces valid structured JSON compliant with the incident schema

features.name: colab_openvino_nncf_int8_quantization
features.title: OpenVINO NNCF INT8 Quantization in Google Colab and Edge Artifact Export
features.description: Apply Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) to the distilled YOLO11n detector using OpenVINO NNCF within the Google Colab environment using a calibration set of 300 intersection frames, exporting optimized OpenVINO IR (.xml/.bin) for laptop deployment.
acceptance: Create colab_notebooks/03_openvino_int8_quantization.ipynb executing nncf.quantize on the distilled detector
Calibrate INT8 weights using representative unlabelled intersection frames across day, dusk, and night conditions
Demonstrate model size reduction >= 60% with mAP@50-95 drop <= 1.5% compared to distilled FP32 model
Package and export calibrated OpenVINO IR artifacts ready for local deployment on laptop CPU achieving >= 25 FPS with < 1.2GB RAM

features.name: llamacpp_gguf_quantization_and_laptop_cpu_benchmarking
features.title: llama.cpp GGUF Quantization (Q4_K_M) and Laptop CPU Execution Benchmarks
features.description: Quantize the fine-tuned forensic auditor to 4-bit GGUF (Q4_K_M) using llama-quantize in Colab, and benchmark on-demand CPU inference latency and memory consumption on the 8GB RAM host via llama-cpp-python.
acceptance: Execute llama-quantize in Colab to generate compact Q4_K_M GGUF model artifact
Integrate quantized GGUF model into local backend using llama-cpp-python with CPU AVX2/AVX-512 optimization
Benchmark forensic report generation ensuring peak RAM consumption <= 1.2GB RSS and response generation time <= 3.5 seconds
Validate deterministic JSON schema parsing on 100 test infraction cases without out-of-memory container crashes

features.name: async_rtsp_stream_ingestion_and_ring_buffer
features.title: Resilient Asynchronous RTSP Ingestion with Ring-Buffer Management
features.description: Construct high-throughput, non-blocking RTSP video stream receiver using asyncio and background threading with a bounded ring buffer that prevents memory leaks and discards stale frames during network jitter.
acceptance: Implement RTSP capture worker with automatic exponential backoff reconnection on socket drops
Maintain lock-free bounded asyncio.Queue ring buffer (max 30 frames) dropping oldest frames to maintain real-time latency (< 200ms glass-to-algorithm)
Expose stream health metrics (FPS, packet drop count, frame decoding latency) via API endpoint
Demonstrate continuous 24-hour stream endurance without memory growth

features.name: fastapi_lifespan_pipeline_architecture
features.title: FastAPI Lifespan Architecture with Async Context Manager
features.description: Architect the core FastAPI inference server using @asynccontextmanager lifespan handling to initialize OpenVINO runtime engines, warm up the llama.cpp GGUF model instance, start background tracking workers, and safely tear down hardware sessions.
acceptance: Implement lifespan(app: FastAPI) context manager initializing OpenVINO compiled models and llama-cpp-python thread pools upon startup
Ensure graceful shutdown intercepting SIGINT/SIGTERM, draining frame queues and saving audit journals
Provide asynchronous health endpoints /health/ready and /health/live reflecting pipeline status and memory headroom
Write pytest test suite verifying context manager initialization, warm-up inference, and resource release

features.name: bytetrack_trajectory_and_wrongway_vector_engine
features.title: ByteTrack Multi-Object Tracking & Kinematic Wrong-Way Vector Engine
features.description: Integrate ByteTrack multi-object tracker with the OpenVINO INT8 detector, projecting tracking centers through homography H into metric coordinates to calculate instantaneous velocity vectors and detect counter-flow violations.
acceptance: Execute ByteTrack ID association on detected bounding boxes across successive video frames
Project bottom-center bounding box foot-points (u, v) into ground plane coordinates (X, Y) via matrix H
Compute smoothed velocity vectors v_t = (p_t - p_{t-k}) / delta_t over a rolling 10-frame window
Evaluate cosine similarity cos(theta) = (v_t . u_legal) / (||v_t|| * ||u_legal||); trigger wrong-way alert when cos(theta) < -0.7 for > 1.0 second duration
Classify violators into categories: vehicular (cars/motorcycles) and high-risk micromobility (bicycles, children on e-scooters)

features.name: evidence_packaging_and_llamacpp_audit_dispatch
features.title: Automated Evidence Packaging and Asynchronous llama.cpp Forensic Audit Dispatch
features.description: When a wrong-way condition is verified, package a rolling 10-second video clip (3s pre-event, 4s event, 3s post-event) and trigger an asynchronous background worker task running llama.cpp with the GGUF model to generate a structured forensic dossier.
acceptance: Maintain circular in-memory buffer of decoded frames to extract 10-second MP4 evidence clips without re-encoding delays
Render visual overlays showing tracked trajectory polyline, velocity vector arrow, violation bounding box, and BEV radar view
Dispatch async background task to llama-cpp-python passing kinematic metadata to produce structured JSON incident description
Store packaged evidence (mp4 clip, keyframe image, JSON metadata) into organized storage volumes /storage/incidents/{date}/

features.name: mlflow_containerized_tracking_server
features.title: Containerized MLFlow Tracking Server and Artifact Repository
features.description: Configure an MLFlow tracking server running in a lightweight Docker container with SQLite backend and local artifact storage to track Colab distillation runs, quantization experiments, and edge production pipeline metrics.
acceptance: Create Dockerfile.mlflow and compose service with SQLite persistent database and volume-mounted artifacts
Restrict MLFlow container memory limit to 1.5GB RAM with auto-restart policy
Configure authentication, experiment hierarchies (colab-distillation-yolo, colab-quantization, edge-runtime-telemetry), and REST API endpoints
Verify artifact logging and UI accessibility via localhost:5000

features.name: experiment_tracking_and_quantization_benchmarks
features.title: Experiment Tracking for Distillation, Quantization, and Latency Telemetry
features.description: Instrument Google Colab distillation and quantization notebooks with MLFlow remote client to log hyperparameters (temperature, loss weights, quantizer bits), performance metrics (mAP, latency distributions, P95/P99), and model artifacts.
acceptance: Log Colab distillation hyperparameters (alpha, beta, gamma, tau, learning rate schedule) and validation metrics to MLFlow
Log OpenVINO NNCF INT8 and llama.cpp GGUF quantization metrics (model size ratio, perplexity/mAP delta)
Log runtime inference latency benchmarks comparing FP32, OpenVINO INT8, and llama.cpp GGUF backends
Register production-candidate INT8 and GGUF model packages in MLFlow Model Registry with transition to 'Staging'

features.name: production_drift_and_memory_telemetry
features.title: Runtime Drift Monitoring and Docker 8GB Budget Telemetry
features.description: Implement an asynchronous background telemetry reporter in FastAPI that pushes real-time runtime metrics (FPS, inference latency, tracking ID switches, memory RSS, CPU load, daily infraction count) to MLFlow and Prometheus metrics endpoint.
acceptance: Collect process and container memory metrics via psutil and /sys/fs/cgroup/memory verifying total consumption <= 8GB
Publish hourly summary metrics to MLFlow run 'production-edge-sentinel' (average FPS, peak RAM, incident counts)
Log tracking confidence drift and trigger automated notification if average detection confidence falls below threshold
Expose /metrics endpoint in Prometheus format for system observability

features.name: nextjs_dashboard_and_websocket_gateway
features.title: Next.js Dashboard Architecture and Real-Time WebSocket Gateway
features.description: Build modern Next.js (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI) frontend connecting via persistent WebSocket to FastAPI backend (/ws/live-alerts) for immediate incident dispatch and live telemetry display.
acceptance: Scaffold Next.js 15+ frontend in frontend/ with Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and responsive layout
Implement robust useWebSocket custom hook with automatic reconnection, heartbeat ping/pong, and notification toasts
Display real-time header widgets for live camera status, stream FPS, CPU/RAM container utilization, and system operational mode
Ensure Next.js production build runs smoothly inside Docker container with <= 1GB RAM footprint

features.name: interactive_incident_timeline_and_dossier_viewer
features.title: Interactive Incident Timeline and Video Dossier Modal
features.description: Develop dynamic, filterable incident timeline interface presenting detected wrong-way events categorized by vehicle type (e-scooter, bicycle, car), with video replay, trajectory path visualizer, and Bird's-Eye View (BEV) radar overlay.
acceptance: Render chronological event cards with timestamp, vehicle badge, direction indicator, and severity level (CRITICAL for child scooter in wrong-way)
Implement modal dossier inspector featuring synchronized MP4 evidence playback with scrubber and pause controls
Render 2D canvas overlay depicting the vehicle's trajectory vector vs legal street flow vector in metric coordinates
Provide multi-criteria filtering by date range, vehicle type, violation confidence, and audit validation status

features.name: forensic_report_and_incident_documentation_export
features.title: Forensic Report Viewer and Residential Administration PDF Export
features.description: Incorporate incident documentation viewer presenting llama.cpp natural language audit summaries and an export engine generating official PDF incident reports for condominium administration and traffic safety committees.
acceptance: Display formatted semantic audit card with llama.cpp narrative: 'Vehículo micromovilidad (scooter eléctrico infantil) circulando en sentido contrario a 17 km/h en carril poniente'
Enable authorized operators to validate, dispute, or add comments to recorded incidents with audit trail logging
Implement client/server PDF generation compiling keyframe snapshots, trajectory map, violation metrics, and committee signature lines
Provide batch CSV/JSON export of historical incidents for traffic engineering and residential council review
